explication: ToolJet is a low-code platform for building internal applications connected to databases, APIs, and SaaS services. The central workflow is to configure an app’s components and queries in the visual builder, run those queries, and use their results in the app. The README also documents ToolJet Database, AI/MCP app generation, workflows, collaboration, and enterprise governance; these remain distinct capability branches. The tree and excerpts give detail for builder/query behavior and app API calls, but not the implementations or wiring of most documented subsystems.
